warmup: Dr. Nair here! Look at the two nuggets. Same color, same shine. Kai says his is GOLD. Drag a block under his sign and see if it holds. The locked blocks are tests. You’ll get those later!
part1: Let’s print a fingerprint for Kai’s silver bolt. Run each test, then flip the switch to match. Then drag the strip along the shelf until every stripe lines up. Which stripe gives it away?
part3: Here’s the test that looking can’t do. Drag each nugget across the white tile and check its streak. Then try the steel nail, and weigh them. Both pieces are the same size!
explore: Three samples, six tests. Drag a test onto a sample’s row and watch the table fill. Then build a claim with two pieces of evidence. One clue alone won’t do!
